listing.name: R.E.L.I.V.E. / Oddworld: Abe's Oddysee
listing.summary: Use an existing permitted R.E.L.I.V.E. copy for Oddworld: Abe’s Oddysee; fresh package acquisition awaits upstream license and integrity evidence.

steps.title: Keep your permitted working copy
steps.instruction: If you already have a permitted working R.E.L.I.V.E. installation for Oddworld: Abe’s Oddysee, keep its corresponding original game files and any progress and settings with that copy.

steps.title: Select that game’s player
steps.instruction: Choose the native game player and working folder from that completed installation. Upstream setup and runtime updates remain with that copy. The two Oddworld games retain separate registrations and original-data identities.

listing.download_block_reason: New downloads are waiting for upstream to publish a clearly licensed stable package, a verifiable download checksum and supported original-game requirements.
